name: gauntlet-loop-brain
title_zh: 把一次任务拆成带裁判和闸门的对抗流水线
tagline_zh: 一个启动词，自动生成耦合感知的构建者、新鲜批评者、受保护闸门、集成检查与显式停止。适合盲比、收敛评审。
tagline_en: One kickoff prompt spawns coupling-aware builders, fresh critics, gated checks, and explicit stops—built for.
desc_en: Design and govern evidence-bound Gauntlet Loops: one initiating prompt that launches coupling-aware builders, fresh critics, protected gates, integration checks, and explicit stop controls. Use for Gauntlet fit decisions, job contracts, reference selection, builder-critic loops, blind comparison, convergence review, and opt-in AI Marketing Hub quality lanes.
why_zh: 批评者每次新建，避免自我重复；闸门受保护，防止构建者绕过检查；停止控制显式，不靠运气收尾。
why_en: Critics are regenerated per loop to avoid echo; gates are tamper-proof; stop controls are explicit—no lucky endings.
limit_zh: 只认 Gauntlet 拟合决策、任务契约、参考选择、构建者-批评者循环、盲比、收敛评审这六类场景；超出此域。
limit_en: Only fits six scenarios: Gauntlet fit, job contracts, reference selection, builder-critic loops, blind comparison, convergence review. Outside.
